A crash between owner/worker configuration writes can leave a mixed pair. stopped_change rejects such a pair before set_pair can reconcile it, conservatively leaving the controller stopped; recovery requires inspection rather than replay.
Projection rejection is not containing-module load-atomic, and load_native can partially copy shared tensors before a later shape error. Discard failed instances.
The six recovery checks exercise extract, parse_header, read_range and fake download, not the complete real run acceptance/cleanup lifecycle. They do not establish real restoration readiness.
review.mechanism_summary: No material unit-launchability defect identified. The float16 NPY fixture has consistent full offsets, role/target dimensions and prefix counts; extraction crosses chunk boundaries and verifies actual prefix values and sidecar identities. Transport tests patch build_opener for every download invocation, preventing real GETs while checking reuse, wrong-version one-attempt preservation and foreign-host rejection. Zero-B shared-gradient equality is explicitly tested. Recursive _load_from_state_dict validation rejects missing, substituted, malformed and NaN projection buffers under both strict settings; valid wrapper serialization is tested separately. The immutable prior implementation is hash-checked before synthetic execution. All outcomes remain unexecuted assertions, not observed passes.
review.lifecycle_summary: The supplied lifecycle gates bind review, deployment, source, contract, revision and recipe; require queue idleness before mutation; stop the controller and acquire the singleton lock before rechecking; and verify configuration bytes during paired updates and compensation. Unknown submission outcomes retain bindings. Restoration requires the exact keyed task's terminal, quiescent, revision/node/recipe-bound attempt proof, or explicit proof submission never started. Inspection checks the exact output whitelist, hashes, clean source and restored configurations. The unit-only argparse action invokes synthetic fixtures and legacy synthetic checks, not restore.run or task training. Eligibility is limited to one managed CPU unit after admission and queue-idle gates; real restoration, its budget, training, metrics and bootstrap remain separately unadmitted.
